open_rope_count: How many open-ended ropes are shown?
Count only the separate ropes with two visible endpoints.
How many string pieces are open rather than closed loops?
Count the open rope components in the diagram.

closed_loop_count: How many separate string pieces form closed loops, including plain rings and knotted closed loops?
Count only the components that are closed loops, including rings and knotted loops.
How many closed string components are visible, counting knotted closed loops as closed?
Count the separate pieces whose ends join to form a loop or ring, including knotted closed loops.
How many rope components are closed rather than open-ended, including any knotted closed loops?
knotted_component_count: How many separate string pieces contain a knot?
Count only the components with a visible self-crossing knot.
How many rope components are knotted?
Count the separate strings that contain a knot, whether or not they are also closed loops.
How many components show a knot?
